messages:
maria_cs: Customer on Dedicated (acct: brightcart-prod) reporting intermittent 429s and long tail latency starting ~09:10 UTC. They say traffic jump from 50->400 qps.
abby_support: Thanks Maria. Any error payloads or timestamps from the API? Customer saw `429` and `504` on retries.
maria_cs: Sent initial logs. Repro steps from customer:
1) run steady 400 qps to dedicated endpoint `api.redwood.ai/v1/dedicated/brightcart` for 5m
2) observe response latencies spiking after ~45s and 429s pile up
Logs: ``[2026-03-18T09:12:03Z] attach: warmpool=0 minreplica=1 current=1 pending=8 probe=throttle``

abby_support: Noted `warmpool=0` and pending attach. I'll triage preflight and billing flags. Customer says they have reserved capacity but recently rotated service account keys last night.
sam_oncall: Ping @lee_eng_platform @nina_sre — could be imagepull/auth rotation causing delayed attach and autoscaler to wait for minReplica handoff.
lee_eng_platform: Looking. Any recent changes to autoscaler heuristics or minReplica enforcement? I see a commit last week to prefer `probe_cooldown`=20s.

nina_sre: I pulled the controller logs for the customer's region:
```controller: scale_decision: desired=12 current=1 min_replica=1 max_replica=100
probes: failures=5 backoff=2m attach_rate=0.4/s
node_autoscaler: throttled=true reason=quota_backoff
```
ops-bot: Incident flag created: #INC-2026-03-dedicated-scale-lag (severity: P2)

abby_support: So chain looks like: token rotation -> imagepull/auth fails -> warmpool empty -> probes failing -> controller respects minReplica but can't attach more -> pending requests queue -> 429s.
maria_cs: Customer specifically called out that this happened right after they rotated GCP service account keys.
sam_oncall: Can we confirm whether the registry pull uses the same SA and whether rotation caused imagepull 401s? Lee, can you grep kube events? 
lee_eng_platform: From node events:
``Failed to pull image "registry.redwood.internal/runtime:75f" - rpc error: code = Unknown desc = unauthorized: authentication required
``` 
Also saw repetitive `AttachPod: backoff due to imagepull` for 90s.

nina_sre: Also controller tried to spin up new pods but cluster autoscaler was throttled (we hit project quota for preemptible nodes last night). So even if the pod could be scheduled, node provisioning was delayed.

abby_support: So two orthogonal bottlenecks: imagepull/auth 401 from SA rotation + node quota throttle. That explains long tail and slow ramp. Customer's billing/iam rotation triggered it.
maria_cs: Customer asks for mitigation steps and reproable workaround.
sam_oncall: Immediate mitigations:
- Roll back service account rotation or re-add registry credentials to the node pool (temp fix).
- Increase warmpool/minReplica to 3 for this customer until the fix (to absorb short spikes).
- Add temporary routing to fallback model in hosted tier for burst traffic.

lee_eng_platform: I'm pushing a quick fix: set warmpool hint for account `brightcart-prod` to `3` and shorten probe cooldown to 5s for next 15m. Will also whitelist the registry token rotation window for imagepull retries.

deploy-bot: Applied config: `warmpool_override:3` for tenant brightcart-prod at 09:32 UTC. Probe cooldown patched in canary.

nina_sre: Meanwhile I'll request quota relief for preemptible nodes and check why cluster autoscaler was marked `throttled=true`. K8s manager says API quota spikes during our maintenance window.

abby_support: Customer update: they rotated the SA in a morning automation job. They've paused rotations for now. They accepted the warmpool tweak.
maria_cs: Customer will monitor for the next 2 hours and sent throughput test harness to validate. They also requested a postmortem and a checklist to avoid rotation-caused outages.

sam_oncall: Follow-ups for eng/platform:
- Improve detection: if imagepull 401s correlate with recent SA updates, auto-warn and prefetch credentials.
- Autoscaler: consider fastpath when pending queue > X (spawn speculative pods in best-effort mode even when node quota is tight).
- Add docs: guidance for service account rotation on Dedicated and recommended warmpool sizing for traffic spikes.

lee_eng_platform: Ack. I'll open a tracking ticket and sketch the spec. We may use a cached warm image to avoid registry auth in critical path.

maria_cs: Thanks all. I'll update the customer and attach the repro steps. Will follow up with the postmortem once engs have the tickets.

abby_support: Closing thread for now, will reopen if 429s reappear. :thumbsup:
